<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="brand" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="100%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#00FBFF"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#09C9E3"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <filter id="shadow" x="-20%" y="-20%" width="140%" height="140%">
      <feDropShadow dx="0" dy="1" stdDeviation="2" flood-color="#1018280D"/>
    </filter>
  </defs>

  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

  <!-- Status bar -->
  <g>
    <text x="18" y="21" font-family="Inter" font-size="12" font-weight="600" fill="#0D0543">9:41</text>
    <line x1="319" y1="17" x2="319" y2="21" stroke="#0D0543" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="323" y1="14" x2="323" y2="21" stroke="#0D0543" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="327" y1="11" x2="327" y2="21" stroke="#0D0543" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="342" cy="17" r="3" fill="none" stroke="#0D0543" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="339" y1="17" x2="345" y2="17" stroke="#0D0543" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="357" y="11" width="20" height="11" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#0D0543" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="359" y="13" width="15" height="7" rx="1" fill="#0D0543"/>
    <rect x="378" y="14" width="2" height="5" rx="1" fill="#0D0543"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Header -->
  <g>
    <polyline points="25,52 18,59 25,66" fill="none" stroke="#0D0543" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <line x1="19" y1="59" x2="39" y2="59" stroke="#0D0543" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="54" y="64" font-family="Inter" font-size="18" font-weight="600" fill="#0D0543">Return an order</text>
    <circle cx="357" cy="58" r="16" fill="#CFCBDC"/>
    <circle cx="357" cy="54" r="4" fill="#0D0543"/>
    <ellipse cx="357" cy="64" rx="7" ry="4" fill="#0D0543"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Five-step progress -->
  <g>
    <line x1="47" y1="105" x2="343" y2="105" stroke="#CFCBDC" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="47" y1="105" x2="195" y2="105" stroke="url(#brand)" stroke-width="3"/>
    <circle cx="39" cy="105" r="20" fill="#0D0543" filter="url(#shadow)"/>
    <polyline points="31,105 37,111 48,99" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <circle cx="113" cy="105" r="20" fill="#0D0543" filter="url(#shadow)"/>
    <rect x="105" y="98" width="16" height="13" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <line x1="108" y1="95" x2="118" y2="95" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <circle cx="187" cy="105" r="20" fill="url(#brand)" stroke="#0D0543" stroke-width="2" filter="url(#shadow)"/>
    <circle cx="187" cy="105" r="7" fill="none" stroke="#0D0543" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="187" y1="101" x2="187" y2="105" stroke="#0D0543" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="187" y1="105" x2="192" y2="108" stroke="#0D0543" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="261" cy="105" r="20" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#CFCBDC" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="254" y="98" width="14" height="14" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#CFCBDC" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <line x1="257" y1="102" x2="265" y2="102" stroke="#CFCBDC" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="257" y1="106" x2="265" y2="106" stroke="#CFCBDC" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <circle cx="335" cy="105" r="20" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#CFCBDC" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <polyline points="328,105 334,111 343,99" fill="none" stroke="#CFCBDC" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <text x="39" y="137" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter" font-size="10" font-weight="500" fill="#0D0543">Order</text>
    <text x="113" y="137" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter" font-size="10" font-weight="500" fill="#0D0543">Product</text>
    <text x="187" y="137" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter" font-size="10" font-weight="600" fill="#0D0543">Method</text>
    <text x="261" y="137" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter" font-size="10" font-weight="500" fill="#CFCBDC">Refund</text>
    <text x="335" y="137" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter" font-size="10" font-weight="500" fill="#CFCBDC">Done</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Main content -->
  <g>
    <text x="20" y="176" font-family="Inter" font-size="20" font-weight="600" fill="#0D0543">How would you like to return it?</text>
    <text x="20" y="201" font-family="Inter" font-size="13" font-weight="400" fill="#0D0543">Choose a return method for the selected item.</text>

    <!-- Product card -->
    <rect x="20" y="220" width="350" height="86" rx="8" fill="#0C0C0D66" opacity="0.08"/>
    <g filter="url(#shadow)">
      <rect x="20" y="218" width="350" height="86" rx="8" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#CFCBDC" stroke-width="1"/>
    </g>
    <rect x="32" y="230" width="64" height="62" rx="6" fill="#CFCBDC"/>
    <circle cx="79" cy="240" r="6" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <polygon points="37,284 52,266 61,276 70,263 91,284" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.9"/>
    <text x="110" y="241" font-family="Inter" font-size="14" font-weight="600" fill="#0D0543">Everyday Knit Sneakers</text>
    <text x="110" y="261" font-family="Inter" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#0D0543">Size 8  ·  Black / White</text>
    <text x="110" y="283" font-family="Inter" font-size="13" font-weight="600" fill="#0D0543">$48.00</text>
    <rect x="304" y="230" width="52" height="22" rx="9999" fill="#00FBFF" opacity="0.35"/>
    <text x="330" y="245" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter" font-size="10" font-weight="600" fill="#0D0543">1 item</text>

    <text x="20" y="337" font-family="Inter" font-size="16" font-weight="600" fill="#0D0543">Return method</text>
    <text x="20" y="359" font-family="Inter" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#0D0543">Select one option to continue.</text>

    <!-- Selected pickup card -->
    <rect x="20" y="373" width="350" height="91" rx="12" fill="#0C0C0D66" opacity="0.08"/>
    <g>
      <rect x="20" y="371" width="350" height="91" rx="12" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#0D0543" stroke-width="2"/>
      <circle cx="48" cy="407" r="11" fill="#0D0543"/>
      <circle cx="48" cy="407" r="4" fill="#00FBFF"/>
      <text x="72" y="399" font-family="Inter" font-size="14" font-weight="600" fill="#0D0543">Free doorstep pickup</text>
      <text x="72" y="420" font-family="Inter" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#0D0543">A courier will collect the item from you.</text>
      <text x="72" y="442" font-family="Inter" font-size="11" font-weight="500" fill="#0D0543">Available tomorrow  ·  No printing required</text>
      <rect x="293" y="388" width="60" height="21" rx="9999" fill="url(#brand)"/>
      <text x="323" y="403" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter" font-size="10" font-weight="600" fill="#0D0543">FREE</text>
    </g>

    <!-- Dropoff card -->
    <g>
      <rect x="20" y="474" width="350" height="82" rx="12" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#CFCBDC" stroke-width="1"/>
      <circle cx="48" cy="515" r="11" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#CFCBDC" stroke-width="2"/>
      <polygon points="48,500 57,509 54,509 54,522 42,522 42,509 39,509" fill="none" stroke="#0D0543" stroke-width="1.5"/>
      <text x="72" y="507" font-family="Inter" font-size="14" font-weight="600" fill="#0D0543">Drop off at a nearby location</text>
      <text x="72" y="529" font-family="Inter" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#0D0543">Bring the packed item to a return point.</text>
      <text x="72" y="548" font-family="Inter" font-size="11" font-weight="500" fill="#0D0543">Find a location after you continue</text>
    </g>

    <!-- Shipping card -->
    <g>
      <rect x="20" y="568" width="350" height="82" rx="12" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#CFCBDC" stroke-width="1"/>
      <circle cx="48" cy="609" r="11" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#CFCBDC" stroke-width="2"/>
      <rect x="41" y="602" width="14" height="12" rx="1" fill="none" stroke="#0D0543" stroke-width="1.5"/>
      <line x1="41" y1="606" x2="55" y2="606" stroke="#0D0543" stroke-width="1.5"/>
      <line x1="45" y1="599" x2="51" y2="599" stroke="#0D0543" stroke-width="1.5"/>
      <text x="72" y="601" font-family="Inter" font-size="14" font-weight="600" fill="#0D0543">Ship it yourself</text>
      <text x="72" y="623" font-family="Inter" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#0D0543">Use the prepaid label provided at the next step.</text>
      <text x="72" y="642" font-family="Inter" font-size="11" font-weight="500" fill="#0D0543">Refund starts after the package is scanned</text>
    </g>

    <!-- Note -->
    <rect x="20" y="668" width="350" height="42" rx="8" fill="#CFCBDC" opacity="0.28"/>
    <circle cx="40" cy="689" r="8" fill="#0D0543"/>
    <text x="40" y="693" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter" font-size="11" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">i</text>
    <text x="57" y="686" font-family="Inter" font-size="11" font-weight="500" fill="#0D0543">Keep the item in its original packaging</text>
    <text x="57" y="701" font-family="Inter" font-size="11" font-weight="400" fill="#0D0543">until your return is complete.</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Footer actions -->
  <g>
    <line x1="20" y1="726" x2="370" y2="726" stroke="#CFCBDC" stroke-width="1"/>
    <g>
      <rect x="20" y="742" width="103" height="40" rx="8" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#0D0543" stroke-width="1.5"/>
      <polyline points="43,762 38,757 43,752" fill="none" stroke="#0D0543" stroke-width="1.7"/>
      <text x="79" y="767" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter" font-size="13" font-weight="600" fill="#0D0543">Back</text>
    </g>
    <g>
      <rect x="135" y="742" width="235" height="40" rx="8" fill="url(#brand)" filter="url(#shadow)"/>
      <text x="244" y="767" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter" font-size="13" font-weight="700" fill="#0D0543">Continue</text>
      <polyline points="326,754 332,762 326,770" fill="none" stroke="#0D0543" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    </g>
  </g>

  <!-- Bottom navigation -->
  <rect x="0" y="800" width="390" height="44" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <line x1="0" y1="800" x2="390" y2="800" stroke="#CFCBDC" stroke-width="1"/>
  <g>
    <polygon points="39,813 47,807 55,813 55,822 49,822 49,816 45,816 45,822 39,822" fill="#0D0543"/>
    <text x="47" y="837" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter" font-size="9" font-weight="600" fill="#0D0543">Home</text>
    <circle cx="125" cy="814" r="7" fill="none" stroke="#CFCBDC" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <line x1="130" y1="819" x2="136" y2="825" stroke="#CFCBDC" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <text x="125" y="837" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter" font-size="9" font-weight="500" fill="#CFCBDC">Search</text>
    <rect x="184" y="807" width="18" height="14" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#CFCBDC" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <line x1="188" y1="812" x2="198" y2="812" stroke="#CFCBDC" stroke-width="1.4"/>
    <line x1="188" y1="816" x2="196" y2="816" stroke="#CFCBDC" stroke-width="1.4"/>
    <text x="193" y="837" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter" font-size="9" font-weight="500" fill="#CFCBDC">Orders</text>
    <circle cx="277" cy="812" r="6" fill="none" stroke="#CFCBDC" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <line x1="273" y1="821" x2="281" y2="821" stroke="#CFCBDC" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <circle cx="282" cy="808" r="2" fill="#EB24BF"/>
    <text x="277" y="837" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter" font-size="9" font-weight="500" fill="#CFCBDC">Account</text>
    <circle cx="343" cy="813" r="7" fill="none" stroke="#CFCBDC" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <polyline points="337,813 341,817 349,808" fill="none" stroke="#CFCBDC" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <text x="343" y="837" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter" font-size="9" font-weight="500" fill="#CFCBDC">Help</text>
  </g>
</svg>
